WHY FIVE FOLD
Why homeowners choose us, and why it matters

Hiring a contractor is a trust decision. You are letting someone into your home, your budget, and your schedule. Most homeowners we talk to have either had a bad experience before or are trying hard to avoid one. Here is how we approach the work differently.

01
Clarity Before Construction

We define scope, budget, and expectations before a single tool is picked up. That conversation protects you from surprises and protects us from doing work that was never agreed to. It is the most important part of the project, and most contractors rush past it.

02
Communication That Does Not Require Chasing

You will not have to wonder what is happening on your project. We set a communication cadence at the start and stick to it. Updates come to you, not the other way around.

03
Craftsmanship That Holds Up

We are careful about what we commit to and careful about how we build it. From structural work to finish details, the standard does not change based on what is visible or hidden.

04
We Deliver What We Agreed To

Scope creep, vague change orders, and after-the-fact surprises are where contractor relationships break down. We manage that proactively so the number you sign is the number you should expect to pay.

THE EXPERIENCE
A better remodeling experience

A well-run remodel is not an accident. It is the result of a defined process that handles the planning, communication, and execution in a way that keeps things organized from start to finish. Most contractors have a process. The difference is whether it actually protects the client.

01
Discover & Plan

We start with your goals, your space, and your budget. This conversation shapes everything that follows. We ask the questions most contractors skip.

02
Design & Scope

We define the work in detail before any agreement is signed. You know exactly what is included, what it costs, and what to expect before the project starts.

03
Build & Communicate

Work moves forward on a defined schedule with regular updates. If something comes up, we address it directly and promptly, not at the end of the job.

04
Final Walkthrough & Support

We close the project with a structured walkthrough, not a rushed handoff. You get a finished space and a clear record of the work that was done.

This Overland Park bathroom remodel started the way every project should: with a defined scope, a clear budget, and a homeowner who knew exactly what to expect before demo began. The result was not just a finished bathroom. It was a project that stayed on schedule, produced zero change order surprises, and left the client confident the job was done right.

Small Changes, Meaningful Improvement

The homeowners did not need a kitchen that felt disconnected from the rest of their home. They needed a brighter, more useful space that improved everyday routines while still feeling natural within the existing house.

CHALLENGE

The existing kitchen felt visually heavy and did not make the best use of the available space.

DESIGN AND CONSTRUCTION RESPONSE

We coordinated practical layout improvements, brighter materials, cabinetry, lighting, surfaces, and details that connect the kitchen to the surrounding rooms.

RESULT

The completed kitchen feels more open, useful, and intentional without losing its connection to the character of the home.

OUR PROCESS

A Clear Path From Early Ideas to Final Walkthrough
Initial Conversation

We discuss your goals, concerns, timing, and what is not working in the current kitchen.

Site Evaluation

We evaluate the space, existing conditions, layout opportunities, and potential project constraints.

Design and Scope Development

We refine the design direction, selections, scope, and investment expectations before construction begins.

Construction and Communication

Our team manages trades, shares progress, and protects the surrounding home.

Final Review

We complete a detailed walkthrough, address remaining items, and make sure the finished space is ready for daily life.

A defined process reduces surprises and gives homeowners clearer decisions at each stage.

Your Whole Home, Thoughtfully Remodeled.

From layout changes to full rebuilds, we help Kansas City homeowners create spaces that finally fit their lives.

Whole Home Renovations Designed Around Your Life

Transform your current house into a more useful, comfortable, and connected home with Five Fold Solutions.

Does Your Home Still Work for You?

A poor layout can make daily life harder than it needs to be. Closed rooms, limited storage, and outdated spaces may keep your house from serving your family well.

Five Fold Solutions provides whole-home renovations for homeowners throughout Johnson County and the greater Kansas City Metro. We bring the design and construction work together, allowing every part of the home to feel connected.

START PLANNING YOUR RENOVATION

Create One Complete Vision for Your Home

Updating several spaces at once requires careful planning. As an experienced design-build contractor, we study how each room connects before construction begins.

Our remodeling contractor team can coordinate projects that include:

Kitchen remodeling with improved storage and flow

Bathroom remodeling focused on comfort and function

Basement finishing that creates useful living space

Home additions for growing families

New flooring, lighting, and interior finishes

Layout changes that improve movement between rooms

We can also connect indoor areas with a new deck or screened porch. This approach creates a consistent design instead of making each space feel like a separate project. One clear plan keeps the entire renovation moving in the same direction.

Why Choose Five Fold Solutions?

A major renovation involves more than selecting cabinets or paint colors. It requires clear decisions about the layout, structural work, materials, and budget.

Five Fold Solutions defines the project scope before construction begins. Our team also provides regular updates, coordinates trusted trades, and documents changes in writing. You will know what is included before work gets underway.

We are licensed and insured, with experience serving homeowners across the Kansas City area. Our work is guided by integrity, careful stewardship, and respect for your property.

How Do Whole Home Renovations Work?

Every successful renovation begins with a strong plan. We guide you through each stage so you can make informed choices with confidence.

Discovery: We discuss your goals, current concerns, preferred style, and investment range.

Design: We develop the layout and define the materials needed for a complete home transformation.

Planning: We confirm the project scope, expected schedule, and construction details.

Construction: Our team manages the work while keeping you informed throughout the build.

Final Review: We inspect the completed spaces with you and address final details.

A defined process replaces uncertainty with clear expectations.

Our Commitment to Whole-Home Craftsmanship
Purpose-driven renovations, transparent from day one.

At Five Fold Solutions, we don’t just update rooms, we realign the entire home around the way you live. That means honest pricing without surprise change-order, daily communication you can count on, and vetted trades who treat your house like their own. 

Whether we’re removing walls, reframing traffic flow, or rebuilding from the studs up, every decision is rooted in integrity, stewardship, and long-term value. The result? Spaces that feel cohesive on day one and still make sense years down the road.

What Does a Whole Home Renovation Cost?

Pricing depends on the size of the home and the amount of structural work involved. Layout changes, home additions, and custom finishes can also affect the total investment.

We provide detailed pricing based on the agreed scope. This gives you a clearer understanding of where your money is going before construction starts.

Build a Home That Finally Fits

Five Fold Solutions manages complex whole home renovations through one coordinated plan, one accountable team, and one clear construction process. Contact us to schedule a consultation and begin creating a home that works better for the way you live.

Olathe Kitchen Remodel with Updated Finishes

Cabinet refacing, new quartz counters, appliances, and tile for a space that works and feels brand new.

Olathe, KS
Cabinets + Hardware + Countertops + Appliances
6 Weeks
0 Surprises
Client Challenge

The homeowners craved a brighter, more contemporary kitchen but needed to stay within a tight budget. A full gut-renovation was off the table, so every dollar had to count. The must-keep items, original base cabinets and existing hardwood floors, added complexity: the old laminate countertop had to be removed without damaging the cabinetry, and any new finishes needed to blend seamlessly with the preserved elements while still delivering a modern feel.

Our Solution

We started by carefully detaching the countertop in sections, protecting the base cabinets and saving the client the cost of replacement. Fresh Shaker-style cabinet faces, matte-black hardware, and a subway-tile backsplash introduced timeless character, while durable quartz counters and a suite of energy-efficient stainless appliances provided the functional upgrade the family wanted. By focusing spend on high-impact surfaces and re-using solid underlying assets, we delivered a light-filled, modern kitchen that met both aesthetic goals and budget proving you don’t have to start from scratch to achieve a stunning transformation

Key Features & Materials

We blended timeless finishes with budget-smart upgrades, delivering a bright, durable kitchen you can cook in, live in, and love for years.
